summary: Full-stack regression on TeamHub archive/reorder across 6 modules (forms, payments, signups, paperwork, attendance, results) + branded share/password-reset links. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed. Frontend (390x844, demo@cheerplanner.app): payments reorder+archive+Show-archived flow verified end-to-end (chevrons, persistence after reload, 'Archived' chip + undo button visible). Results screen toggles appear once a result exists; result-archive-{id} per-row button present. Paperwork and Attendance header toggles verified visible. Branded link verified: /api/team/share returns https://cheer-planner.com/api/public/s/..., /api/auth/forgot-password response leaks no emergent.host / emergentagent.com / app.cheer-planner.com host. No deprecated expo packages introduced in the touched screens.
critical_code_review_comments: comp_results.reorder_results / archive_result don't raise 404 when the user has no household — _resolve_active_household can return None and the code dereferences h['id']. In practice require_team_access + having created a result guarantees a household, but a defensive None-check is cheap.

payments / paperwork / attendance / forms / signups reorder endpoints silently ignore ids that don't belong to the household (good), but also don't return which ids were applied — fine for the current UX, flag only as a nice-to-have.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows exercised (payments full cycle incl. reorder persistence + archive hide/show; results toggles after seed; paperwork+attendance header toggles)

seed_data_creation: Created transient trackers/results for the UI test and deleted them after; also cleaned stale ZTest_/T_ prefixed data from previous iterations (payment_trackers x2 removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: POST /api/auth/login, token stored in web localStorage under a key containing 'ct_auth_token' as a JSON string (strip surrounding quotes before using in Authorization header). The demo account has an active Welcome Tour on first entry to Team screens — dismiss via get_by_text('Skip'). Reorder toggle only renders when >1 items exist (by design). Results toggles render only when role === 'staff'.
